intro: Livestock and money from Somalis abroad are the backbone of the economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Somalia is one of the world's biggest exporters of camels, goats and sheep, mostly to the Gulf. Mobile money is very widely used.

chapters.title: Fishing
text: The long coast has rich fishing waters.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Somalia makes and sells to the world.
